[[File:ergoshiprear.png|thumb|250px|The smuggler ship (rear view) docked with Fuel Station Ergo.]]
This '''[[smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[starship/Legends|ship]]''' operated under the interests of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Dark Trooper Project]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Eventually it was raided by [[agent/Legends|agent]] [[Kyle Katarn]] in order to reach the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] ''[[Executor/Legends|Executor]]''.

==Description==
[[File:ergoshipmap.png|thumb|250px|left|Layout of the smuggler ship]]
The ship had a rectangular shape. Inside, it had white corridors with panels, not unlike the interior of a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]]. The square-shaped [[bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] was accessed by the means of a [[keycard/Legends|keycard]]. The ship proper was flanked by two rectangular cargo bays.<ref name="dark">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref>

Two corridors overlooked the cargo bays below. A stairway on the rear-port side of the ship led to them. The bays were divided in three sections each, and had sliding platforms.<ref name="dark" />

==History==
The Dark Trooper Project was developed in the facility ''[[Arc Hammer]]'', which was making leaps to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to keep its status secret. Only the ''Executor'' knew its location at each given time. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] offered the smugglers whom the Empire employed to make the necessary trips to deliver the materials that the Dark Trooper Project needed across the galaxy.<ref name="dark" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had employed agents [[Jan Ors]] and Kyle Katarn to sabotage the Project, and the only way to reach the top secret factory was via the ''Executor''.<ref name="dark" />

Knowing that the Super Star Destroyer was supplied from [[Fuel Station Ergo/Legends|Fuel Station Ergo]], Ors tasked Kyle Katarn to disguise as a smuggler and [[Mission to Fuel Station Ergo|hijack a smuggler ship]] resupplying in the [[Space station/Legends|station]]. That time the smuggler ship was docked at the northwestern [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] and its bays were full of [[cargo container/Legends|cargo containers]], some with class 5 explosives, some with [[Personal energy shield/Legends|shields]], some with bio-tests. [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] and [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] roamed its corridors.<ref name="dark" />
[[File:smuggleshipbridge.png|thumb|250px|The bridge of the ship.]]
Meanwhile Katarn redirected the movable fueling arm towards the docking bay of the target smuggler ship, which he boarded. Inside the ship however were several who tried to stop him. Katarn stole a yellow keycard from an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] he killed, which allowed him access to the [[bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]. He activated the engines, but not before exchanging one last parting message with Ors over [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. With the hijacked ship, he was able to reach the ''Executor''.<ref name="dark" />

Eventually the ship made its way to the hanger of the ''Executor''. However Imperial forces boarded the ship in order to stop Katarn from exiting the bridge. Katarn made his way down to the now-empty cargo bays, and exited the ship to the main area of the Super Star Destroyer and continued [[Mission_to_the_Executor|his mission]].<ref name="dark" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:smuggledockedergo.png|thumb|250px|Map of the shp in mission 11, docked on Ergo. The cargo bays are full of containers. The areas inaccessible to the scenario are not designed by the game engine.]]
The ship only appears in the [[1995]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''; it is the objective of the mission 11 ("Smuggler's Hijack") being the destination the player must reach in order to complete the mission. It appears again in the beginning of the mission 12 ("The Stowaway") from where the player needs to leave in order to reach the ''Executor''.

The ship's name, type and model are not specified neither in the game or the [[Dark Forces Official Player's Guide|player guide]]. The ship itself is seen externally, only from the rear side. The shape tentatively resembles a [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]], a class of ship that first appeared a few years earlier in the video games ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing|Star Wars: X-wing]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter]]''.
